The letter E is located toward the lower left of the image, near the adult form at the bottom center; this adult has a slender body, very long legs, and narrow wings, and its appearance is like a crane fly-type insect. Reasoning: The question asks what E in the image is. E is marked next to this adult with long legs and narrow wings, and this adult in the life history diagram is a crane fly. Therefore E represents crane fly.
